doc:decision:wasm-sentinel-vs-panic Decision (2026-04-12): WasmRunner sentinel pattern chosen over hard failure for InferletService::default(). Rationale: daemon initialization should never panic — WASM inferlets are an enhancement, not a core dependency. Alternatives: (1) Option<InferletService> — rejected, breaks all callers; (2) panic! — rejected, crashes daemon in CI/sandboxed envs; (3) sentinel — accepted, fails gracefully at module-load time not at init.

doc:pattern:rust:3tier-fallback-constructor 3-tier fallback constructor pattern for optional dependencies (2026-04-12): When a struct wraps an optional heavy dependency (WASM engine, GPU, etc), provide 3 ctors: (1) preferred() with full config, (2) lightweight() without expensive allocations, (3) sentinel() using defaults that always succeed. Default trait impl chains all 3. Never panic in Default.

pattern:rust:test-only-reexports-cfg-test pub(crate) use items only accessed in inline #[cfg(test)] modules must be gated with #[cfg(test)] at the re-export site. Without gating, clippy -D warnings fires unused_imports on every non-test build. Pattern: add #[cfg(test)] before each pub(crate) use block that feeds inline test suites via use super::*.

pattern:rust:mcts-materializer-skip-logic mcts_materializer.rs skips subgoals with source==fallback OR source==no_cognitive_runtime. In test environments without a live cognitive engine, all results are no_cognitive_runtime, causing materialized=0. Fix: only skip source==fallback (CILA L0-L1 with zero signal). no_cognitive_runtime carries a usable complexity score and should materialize. Lesson: don't conflate infrastructure absence with signal absence.

lesson:staticprefixpattern-vs-regex-2026-04-25 StaticPrefixPattern lesson: for validator patterns that test command prefixes (rm, dd, mkfs, etc.), starts_with O(m) is 15x faster than regex. Create a separate type to make intent explicit and allow the compiler to enforce which patterns need regex vs prefix-only. Only the catch-all pattern needs full regex semantics.

lesson:fast-content-hash-prefilter-2026-04-25 fast_content_hash lesson: AES-NI polynomial hash (stringzilla::hash) is NOT cryptographic but 10-100x faster than blake3. Use it as a pre-filter in quick_content_changed() — if hashes differ, skip blake3 entirely. If hashes match, still run blake3 for authoritative result. This pattern eliminates 90%+ of blake3 calls for unchanged files. Never replace blake3 with fast_hash for security contexts.

lesson:bktree-lazy-seed-2026-04-25 BK-tree lazy-seed lesson: BkTreeFuzzyAdapter::top_k() should lazy-seed the BK-tree on first call rather than eager build. When pool is empty (cold start, empty context), eager build wastes time. Lazy seed: check if root is None, build from pool, then query. sz_edit_distance (stringzilla simd-fuzzy feature) achieves O(log N) per query vs O(N*m*n) for Vec brute-force — ~2125x speedup at N=10000.

pattern:onceLock-cache-invalidation-2026-04-25 OnceLock cache invalidation pattern: for caches that need invalidation (e.g. gotcha patterns loaded once), use OnceLock<Vec<T>> for the cache and a separate AtomicBool or generation counter for dirty tracking. On cache miss or dirty flag, reload from DB and reset flag. Avoids Mutex overhead for read-heavy workloads. See async_knowledge.rs gotcha_count_for_file for reference implementation.

gotcha:rust-child-drop-does-not-reap:2026-05-23 Rust std::process::Child has Drop impl that ONLY closes the file descriptor — it does NOT call waitpid(). Discarding a Child without explicit .wait() leaves a zombie process until the parent exits. Long-running daemons that fire-and-forget subprocess spawns will accumulate zombies until PID exhaustion. Fix: always .wait() or use a per-spawn thread that wait()s. Avoid global SIGCHLD/SA_NOCLDWAIT if other code in the same process needs exit codes.
